about: Starter editions: statewide contacts for states without county-level research yet. Every county routes to the state veterans agency plus national aging, ombudsman and Medicare counseling locators. Each veterans phone was matched to the agency's own website on the review date. Run scripts/make_starter_states.py after editing, then scripts/build_public.py.
